plugins.name: auto-model-router
plugins.description: Per-prompt model routing for Claude Code. Classifies each prompt into a tier (trivial/standard/complex/deep), auto-delegates work to a router-{haiku|sonnet|opus} worker subagent at high confidence, asks before delegating when ambiguous. Plan mode enforces per-step Model: tags. Bundles a UserPromptSubmit hook, two skills, three subagents, two slash commands, and a cc-route CLI wrapper for session-launch routing.
